canonical_integrity: Canonical DATA remains byte-equivalent to the protected source and retains the fixed SHA-256.
Exactly 50 canonical nodes and the six object types remain intact.
Canonical text, relation participants, references, rights, citations, public URLs, and research annex routes remain unchanged unless a structural wrapper change is explicitly required.
single_production_architecture: The production build imports and executes the same state, domain, transaction, layout, pointer, Reader, Route, trace, View, Solo, overlay, tooltip, accessibility, and environment modules exercised by tests.
src/app.js is a composition/bootstrap root, not a second implementation of those systems.
No semantic behavior has two independently maintained implementations.
The static GitHub Pages artifact remains deterministic, local-first, backend-free, and independent of runtime external APIs.
product_and_experience_semantics: Reading anchor, Field attention, Reader subject, projected-edge inspection, View, Solo, Route, trace, overlays, responsive surface, and lifecycle state remain distinct.
Direct new-object commit appends exactly one Route event; same-object activation, replay, preview, inspection, View, Solo, chamber changes, About, and camera changes append none.
Route history has no semantic cap; visible presentation may be windowed without deleting events.
Route, wear, and afterglow remain materially and semantically distinct.
RelO attention appears as one continuous masked clearing without member bubbles or spokes.
Solo membership and exit restoration follow the committed contracts exactly.
Hidden targets remain addressable through Reader, Index, Route replay, and projected-edge inspection without silently restoring forbidden visibility.
Desktop and mobile are projections of one semantic session.
spatial_and_visual_system: The authored world is fixed at 1000x760; viewport changes alter projection, not topology.
Neutral and focused geometry is deterministic.
Camera framing respects safe rectangles and occupancy contracts.

Label placement evaluates all eight candidates, scores every valid candidate, preserves required-priority labels without required-label overlap, and suppresses lower-priority labels when no valid placement exists.
The Black Bird retains its aperture role.
The apparatus recedes behind the poem without obscuring capability or state.
Compact and mobile compositions contain no sheet leak, label collision, clipped required content, or chrome/focus conflict.
accessibility_and_resilience: Keyboard, mouse, touch, pen, screen-reader, reduced-motion, forced-colors, 200% text resize, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, missing-font, visual-viewport, orientation, suspension/resume, pointer-cancel, and mixed-input paths remain operable.
No serious or critical Axe violation is excluded.
Interface text and essential labels meet applicable contrast requirements while preserving authored recession through compliant color, weight, halo, stroke, opacity, or material differences.
Dialogs have accessible names; modal focus is contained and restored; graph focus uses one roving tab stop; tooltip lifecycle and aria-describedby association are complete.
evidence_truth: Candidate evidence is generated from one exact frozen branch-head SHA.
Synthetic PR-merge verification is recorded separately and never substituted for the candidate SHA.
Every required screenshot, recording, and machine report is an individually required manifest entry.
Every capture proves its named state through executable preconditions and postconditions.
Contact sheets are supplementary review aids only.
Broken, blank, duplicate, stale, mixed-SHA, undersized, unprobeable, mislabeled, or partially established evidence fails the gate.
